about: Comparisons no golden has shown yet: an object beside a string under CONTAINS and NOT CONTAINS; a number beside a list holding a list under NOT IN; a number beside a list of numbers or of strings under CONTAINS ANY and NOT CONTAINS ANY; a header value beside a list under CONTAINS ANY and NOT CONTAINS ANY; a selection holding null under NOT CONTAINS ANY; a number on the left of IS SUBSET and NOT CONTAINS ANY beside a GENERAL PIP that answers 404; and conditions of three OR groups, one with AND, that come out false or fail the decision. Each comparison is `<comparison> OR resource.a == 'y'`, asked with resource.a 'n' and 'y'. Where both answers are false, the same condition in the DENY rule of a PERMIT_UNLESS_DENY set and policy, asked with resource.a 'n', tells an ended rule (true) from a failed decision (false).
